allocations_investor_terms.name: allocations_investor_terms
allocations_investor_terms.value: kind = 'partner' or (basis is not null and rate_pct is not null and amount >= 0)

money_entries_amount_sign.name: money_entries_amount_sign
money_entries_amount_sign.value: case when type in ('opening', 'opening_correction') then amount <> 0 else amount > 0 end

money_entries_receipt_no_payment.name: money_entries_receipt_no_payment
money_entries_receipt_no_payment.value: receipt_no is null or (type = 'customer_payment' and reverses_id is null)

sales_invoice_no_not_reversal.name: sales_invoice_no_not_reversal
sales_invoice_no_not_reversal.value: invoice_no is null or reverses_id is null
